            Personality traits

            Each trait sits between two opposites. Slide toward the one that fits him.

            At first glance

            Up to five things anyone would notice.

            Description

            In sections, each with an optional heading. A whole Total RP 3 description can be pasted into one section; its markup carries over.

            Formatting, as in Total RP 3
            {h1}Title{/h1}
            A heading. {h2} and {h3} are smaller. Add :c or :r to centre it or align it right, as in {h2:c}.
            {p:c}Text{/p}
            A centred paragraph. {p:r} aligns it right.
            {col:ffd100}Text{/col}
            Coloured text. The game's colour codes (|cffffd100Text|r) work too. Pale colours are darkened so they stay readable on parchment.
            {link*https://…*Text}
            A link. Only http and https addresses become links.
            A blank line
            Starts a new paragraph. A single line break stays a line break.

            Icons and images ({icon:…}, {img:…}) are game files, so they are left out.

              Record an encounter

              No one else sees this encounter at all, not even that it exists. All of it is encrypted before it is stored, with a key that only your word unlocks. Records that name it link to it only for you.

              Art Pieces

                Add a form

                One of the shapes he takes, such as his Dracthyr form or his visage. Its art pieces are shown together, under its name.

                The art pieces will be shown here.

                Add an art piece

                Images and videos

                The first is the main one, shown in the list; the others are its alternate versions. Tick Mature on any that is for adults only: it stays covered until a visitor says they are 18 or older.

                Pictures (PNG, JPEG or WebP) are scaled to 2400 pixels on the long side, and nothing but the picture is kept. GIFs keep their animation, up to 40 MB. Videos can be MP4 (H.264) or WebM, up to 90 MB; tick Loop for a short animation. GIFs and videos lose any notes they carry, such as where they were made.
